text: Stigi. A feedback board where you teach an agent by dragging two notes.
This is sample data: two hundred synthetic comments for a fictional expenses app, already filed into themes.
But the plan and billing complaints are scattered across the wrong clusters.
Drag one onto New cluster. Drag a second. No prompt.
The agent names the theme, and pulls in every matching note, each with a one-line reason.
Sort with agent files the unsorted pile in one small batch.
Then the agent writes the insight report. Edit a line, and export Markdown.
The board and the agent use the same actions, over one database.
Stigi. Live at stigi dot suitz dot x y z.
